verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026. official_url now points at the draft's own text: the English 'Draft National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2025-2030', prepared by MPTC and dated June 2025 (29 pages), the copy that the OECD.AI Policy Navigator entry links on OECD.AI's file storage (api.oecd.ai; the entry was updated by Cambodia's national contact point). MPTC's consultation announcement distributed the draft through a QR code, and no copy on an MPTC site is stored. The draft confirms the title, MPTC as author, the date June 2025, its draft status, priority 5, the 41 measures and the implementation mechanism. Also stored and read: MPTC's press release of 22 April 2025 on the deep-dive workshop (mptc.gov.kh; the previous official_url, copy of 12 Oct 2026), MPTC's announcement opening the public consultation (posted under 1 June 2025) and its release of 13 May 2025 on consultation meetings with ministries, all announcements, and the OECD.AI entry (the secondary source, copy of 18 Oct 2026), which gives the Khmer title and lists the strategy as proposed or under development. Whether the stored draft is the same text MPTC put to consultation is not stated in it. No adoption decision appears in any stored file.

judgment.status_reasoning: The stored text is a draft ('Draft National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2025-2030', June 2025) that calls itself a living document; MPTC put it to public consultation until 20 June 2025, and the OECD.AI entry, updated by Cambodia's national contact point on 9 June 2026, still lists it as proposed or under development. No stored file shows adoption. Draft / proposed.
judgment.date_reasoning: The draft's cover gives June 2025, and the consultation opened on 1 June 2025; date_published 2025-06 keeps the draft's own precision.
judgment.scope_reasoning: National AI strategy draft with a full priority on ethical and responsible AI (risk assessments, safety evaluation datasets, incident response); in scope with no note; unchanged.
judgment.source_kind_reasoning: The PDF is the draft's own text; it is published on OECD.AI's storage through the entry that Cambodia's national contact point maintains, and MPTC's announcement distributed the draft through a QR code, so it is labelled official as the instrument's text.
